Maya (CS): Quick Day0 for Halo private deploy. Open items: egress whitelist, service account perms for model pulls, KMS ACL + rotation plan, and audit log ingestion to Splunk with mTLS. @Sam can you own SA/IAM? :wave:
Sam (Eng-Infra): Yep. What SA name and where are models stored?
Raj (Halo-Infra): Creating `halo-rw-sa` in project `halo-prod`. Models live in GCS `gs://halo-models`.
Sam (Eng-Infra): Plan to grant `roles/storage.objectViewer` and `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` once SA exists. Any KMS rotation constraints?
Priya (Security): Rotation cadence is quarterly per contract. KMS key must allow `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` for Redwood SA and `roles/cloudkms.viewer` for halo-security@halo.example.com. Key resource: `projects/halo-prod/locations/global/keyRings/halo-kr/cryptoKeys/halo-key-a`.
Raj (Halo-Infra): Audit endpoint: https://splunk.halo.example/services/collector — we can provide client certs (or CSR). Sample event payload: ```json
{"ts":"2026-03-10T08:00:00Z","service":"halo-agent","event":{"type":"model.pull","model":"halo-13b","status":"ok","bytes":98765}}
```
Ben (SRE): mTLS required, TLS1.2+, and HMAC header `X-Event-Signature` for integrity. Whitelist egress ranges: 35.196.0.0/14, 34.120.0.0/14 on ports 443 and 10250 for metrics/healthchecks.
runbook-bot: Runbook created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/halo-week0 — includes onboarding checklist and KMS rotation doc.
Maya (CS): Action summary: 1) Raj upload certs and sample events to runbook; 2) Sam apply IAM/storage roles after SA exists; 3) Priya finalize/sign KMS policy; 4) Ben validate Splunk ingestion and HMAC. Target: EOD tomorrow PST. Any blockers? :thumbsup:
Raj (Halo-Infra): :thumbsup: aiming EOD PST. Will DM certs to secure handoff doc.
Maya (CS): Thanks — I will update the runbook with owners/ETAs and follow up in morning.
